name: mad-sil-testing
description: Software-in-the-Loop testing for MaD Control with firmware emulator

scripts.build:firmware: cd ../Firmware/MaDCore && pio run -e native && mkdir -p ../SIL/build/firmware && cp .pio/build/native/program ../SIL/build/firmware/mad-firmware-native.bin
scripts.build: npm run build:firmware && npm run build:app
scripts.setup: npm install && python3 -m venv venv && ./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt

author: Riley McCarthy
